## About
425 Plumbing is a family owned company offering residential and commercial plumbing across King County, from our shop on NE 21st Pl in Bellevue. Paul Hakimi leads the team as CEO and plumber, working alongside plumbers Reza Esmaeili and Kio Najar.
We handle the everyday stuff, like a leaky faucet, a clogged toilet or a slow drain, and the bigger jobs too: sewer lines, water heaters, underground leaks and water damage cleanup. Our team is licensed and insured, and we're glad to come out to your home or office.
Neighbors have rated us 5 from 30 reviews on Google. Two reviewers name the people they worked with: Donald says he can trust Pedram with anything, and Michael says Payman and his team worked with their insurance company USAA after a bathroom leak.

## Services
- Plumbing Repairs: Leaks, broken fixtures and anything else that stops working. We're available 24/7 for repair services, so call any time.
- Plumbing Rooter Service: Rooter service for slow and clogged drains, wherever the clog is hiding.
- Comprehensive Hydro-Jetting Services: Hydro-jetting to clear blockages and clogged drains at a competitive price.
- Plumbing Video Camera Inspection: We run a camera on a flexible rod through an existing entry point, share the images with you right away, and fix the problem without tearing up good pipe.
- Sewer Line Repair and Replacement: Debris and tree roots can grow into your sewer line and cause damage. We repair or replace it for homes and commercial properties.
- Water Heater Repair and Replacement: If your water heater is leaking, making strange noises or not giving you steady hot water, we'll repair it or help you replace it.
- Plumbing Installation: New plumbing installed with top-quality products and our own designs.
- Water Damage and Restoration: We find the cause of the water damage, stop it, then remove, clean up and restore your property. We deal directly with your insurance company so you don't have to.

## FAQ
Q: When can I call you?
A: Any day of the week. We're listed as Open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday.

Q: Do you charge overtime for nights or weekends?
A: No. We don't add an overtime charge.

Q: Can I get a free estimate?
A: Yes. Call, text or email us, or fill out the form, and talk with one of our plumbers to request a free estimate.

Q: Will you work with my insurance on water damage?
A: Yes. On water damage and restoration jobs we deal directly with your insurance company. One reviewer, Michael, says Payman and his team worked with USAA to cover what could be covered.

Q: What should I do first if I find a leak?
A: Shut off the water at the main valve to stop the flow, then give us a call.
